beats.say: Cristiano Ronaldo has more Ballon d'Or nominations than anyone.
Eighteen nominations is more than a month of daily awards.
But he never won it as many times as Messi.
Messi holds the record with eight golden balls.
The award started with Stanley Matthews in 1956.
He was 41, the oldest winner ever.
Ronaldo of Brazil won it at 21, the youngest.
George Weah was the first non-European winner in 1995.

facts: Cristiano Ronaldo earned the most nominations with eighteen.
Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d'Or a record eight times.
Stanley Matthews was the inaugural winner and the oldest player to win at 41 years, 321 days old.
Ronaldo of Brazil became the youngest winner ever at 21 years, 96 days old.
George Weah became the first non-European to win the award in 1995.
